title: The Agent-tool fallback works in a host project whose worktrees sit under .claude/ (second-project run)
goal: A host project's Agent-tool fallback worker can edit its worktree's files: the default worktree_dir is outside .claude/, or the skill says which setting the host changes

run:
import re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_base
default = bl_base.SETTINGS["worktree_dir"][1]
outside = not re.sub(r"^\./", "", default).startswith(".claude")
text = open("skills/sprint/SKILL.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
said = any("Agent tool" in ln and "fallback" in ln and re.search(r"worktree_dir|worktree\.baseDir|baseDir", ln) for ln in text.splitlines())
print("default worktree_dir:", default, "outside .claude:", outside, "skill names the setting:", said)
sys.exit(0 if outside or said else 1)

notes: Run findings 12 and 13: Edit on src/greet.py in .claude/worktrees/agent-... was refused: requested permissions to edit ... which is a sensitive file.
